steps.text: Plug the Diagnostics Keypad into an outlet at the test location.

notes: It is a powerline-only tabletop unit; move it to other outlets as needed during tests.

steps.text: Tap the UNLINK button to remove the link from the unit under test.

notes: Unlink the unit under test when testing is done; otherwise it keeps a responder link to the Diagnostics Keypad.
UNLINK, RELINK and LOCK/UNLOCK work only with devices that have i2CS firmware (shipped spring 2012 or later).
A device can be unlinked this way only if it was the last device linked; otherwise remove the link with home automation software or a factory reset of that device.
Tap the RELINK button to link the last unit under test again.
